-# ULS HDC System
-
-The Student Cumulative Record System for the Human Development Center at the University of La Salette, Santiago City.
-
-## Features
-- Role-based access (Student, Counselor, Director).
-- Form 5 (Cumulative Record) digital wizard.
-- SATA entrance test result encoding.
-- Real-time appointment booking and notifications.
-- Real-time activity logs and table updates.
-- Backblaze B2 cloud storage for student photos.
-
-## 🚀 Setup Instructions
-
-### 1. Prerequisites
-Ensure you have the following installed:
-- PHP 8.2+
-- Composer
-- Node.js & NPM
-- MySQL
-- A [Backblaze B2](https://www.backblaze.com/) account (for cloud storage).
-
-### 2. Installation
-Clone the repository and install dependencies:
-```bash
-composer install
-npm install
